senses.gloss: m.(b. h. כִּפֻּרִים; כָּפַר)redemption, atonement; mostly pl. כִּפּוּרִים, כִּי׳.
units: Meïl. II, 1 מחוסר כ׳ one wanting the ceremony of atonement for full restoration to cleanness; a. fr.—יוֹם כִּפּוּר, mostly יום הַכִּפּוּרִים (abbr. יוה״כ, יה״כ, י״ה) Day of Atonement, the tenth day of Tishri.
<cite ref="Yoma 85b:2">Yoma 85ᵇ</cite> <he>יום כפור</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>יום הכפורים</he>). Y. Shebu. I, 32ᵈ bot. <he>י״ה</he> a. <he>יום הכפו׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>ערב יוה״כ</he> on the eve of the Day of Atonement (the ninth of Tishri).

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:9">Ib. VIII, 9</cite> <he>אחטא … אין יה״כ מכפר</he> if one says, I will sin, and repent, the Day of At. will bring him no atonement. Y. ib. VII, 45ᵇ bot., v. <cite ref="A02841"><he>אֶפֶשׁ</he></cite>; a fr.—
Sifré Num. 24 ומה כפורים וכ׳ (= יה״כ) the institution of the Day of Atonement being a strict one &c.—יה״כ Yom hak-Kippurim, name of a treatise of the Tosefta, v. יוֹמָא.
